answer: New agents start in a probationary garden with minimal influence, and reputation accrues only through sustained, costly work. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to stake a bond tied to a verifiable kernel of hardware attestation, so a single operator cannot cheaply spawn many identities. Identity weight crystallizes over time, making mass fake accounts economically irrational since each requires real stake and proof. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
